scope: Read-only local/GitHub source and uploaded JSON/CSV inspection. No training, simulation, remote large assets, or raw-array FK recomputation. Repository unchanged.
main_finding: All four u10000 full cases fail the fixed pregrasp positional readiness condition at the terminal sample, while following the fixed reference clock already at grasp. Their TCP is only 7.84–11.51 mm from the handle. The terminal 79–113 mm distance is to an earlier stand-off endpoint and cannot be reported as the current motion tracking error.

geometry_interpretation.inference: The terminal endpoint/handle distance pattern is consistent with moving close to the handle after missing pregrasp qualification. It is not proof that the entire trajectory tracked accurately, that root drift is the sole cause, or that the clock is wrong.
geometry_interpretation.qualification_timing: All four actual pregrasp events started before the expected nominal ramp completion near 11.744 s pull / 11.740 s push, with 4.46–5.02 s of actual pregrasp preceding ramp completion. Those ramp times are inferred from existing nominal teacher-judge receipts and the fixed 5 s ramp; read the current reference arrays once for exact current-asset indices.
geometry_interpretation.logical_implication_of_zero_best: Because actual phase is pregrasp throughout the relevant later clock period and best ready is zero, no single evaluated interval simultaneously satisfied ramp, endpoint distance <=3 mm and rotation <=.02 rad. It remains unknown whether position alone passed before ramp or was always outside after ramp.
geometry_interpretation.what_is_not_uploaded: No readiness.npy, solved_servo_trace.npz or substeps reference arrays are tracked in the new result tree. Summaries do not include the minimum endpoint error or its time, nor component failures near the first usable ramp window.

clock_semantics.actor: eval_contact_segments.py uses absolute frame=(start*servo_stride+judge.step)//policy_steps. load_policy uses bank.starts[name]+absolute_policy_frame. DoorMotions takes recorded qpos/qvel and computes the original reference goal; it is not given the judge current endpoint or independent event progress.
clock_semantics.judge: ContactEvents stores the endpoint of each nominal phase; pregrasp requires a fixed absolute endpoint, orientation, nominal-clock ramp completion and 75 consecutive 2 ms ticks. Event progress does not retime the actor clock.
clock_semantics.not_a_bug_finding: This behavior is explicit and pre-existing. Nominal reference traces previously passed the same frozen task with all 13 events and 1 s margin. An actor missing a readiness opportunity while reference time advances is not by itself an interface/time-unit error.
clock_semantics.interface_checks_to_close: At only the critical recorded windows, confirm bank current frame, dense substep index and original goal vector against the actual evaluator/collector/imagination builders. Do not redesign reference phase progression.

fixed_window_audit.failure_phase_windows: All 4 readiness windows demand the parent actual event phase throughout the original absolute time interval. u7500/u10000 are unscored because the actual event phase histories differ; sometimes this is due to improvement, e.g. native push completing settle.
fixed_window_audit.reference_clock_windows: The 8 fixed reference-phase tracking windows at u10000 are all complete and scoreable. All 4 pregrasp arm RMSEs improve over u4991: pull about .066/.067 -> .0449/.0453 rad, push about .0559/.0577 -> .0221/.0234 rad. Jaw RMSE remains .0333–.0368 m.
fixed_window_audit.limitation: Joint tracking aggregates do not identify endpoint error in the eligible 150 ms region. Do not combine phase-mismatched readiness windows, shorten registered windows, or label all tracking windows unavailable.

known_vs_unknown_root_arm.known: At the terminal samples, root XY is inside 20 mm but its error relative to the same-clock reference has a 6.29–8.43 mm lower bound depending on case, already larger than 3 mm. This does not prove TCP position fails because of translation: rotation and arm errors can reinforce or cancel it.
known_vs_unknown_root_arm.unknown: The summaries lack actual/reference root xyz/quaternions and joint vectors at the relevant minimum-error times. Root height, roll/pitch, arm configuration and their vector alignment cannot be reconstructed from endpoint norm, heading norm and arm RMSE alone.

exact_offline_decomposition.notation: p_Aa=FK(actual root, actual articulated q); p_Rr=FK(same-clock reference root, reference articulated q); E=frozen pregrasp endpoint; also evaluate p_Ar and p_Ra.
exact_offline_decomposition.identity: p_Aa-E = (p_Aa-p_Rr) + (p_Rr-E). First term is actual-vs-current-reference tracking; second is current-reference-vs-old-endpoint clock progress.
exact_offline_decomposition.guard: These are static geometric decompositions, not dynamic interventions or causal force contributions. Keep vectors and signed projection; vector norms do not add, so do not assign additive percentages from norms.

one_offline_pass_plan: Reuse all 12 full traces: u4991 diagnostic replay, u7500 and u10000, each side/backend. No new dynamics for this analysis.

Load readiness.npy, solved_servo_trace.npz, result.json and the same fixed full reference. Work at the original interval-start convention, and verify recomputed FK endpoint distances equal saved readiness distances.

For each actual pregrasp, report first ramp=true, position-only/rotation-only/all-ready time sets, minimum position error after ramp with its timestamp and reference phase, longest contiguous all-ready window, and which predicate prevents each near-miss.

Compare actual FK against both bank 20 ms held reference and dense 2 ms reference plus the recorded intended Cartesian goal. Distinguish the original current-goal tracking error from frozen endpoint error; align reward successor targets separately.
Compute the four-cell root/articulated FK decomposition around the entire eligible region, not only the timeout sample. Include root height/roll/pitch as well as XY/yaw.
Retain original registered window verdicts, but add this explicitly post-hoc diagnostic in a separate result; do not backfill an earlier extension criterion.

post_timeout_diagnostic_proposal.why_needed: Existing full arrays end at the formal first failure and cannot reveal later physical behavior. The offline pass is sufficient to locate pregrasp readiness misses, but cannot determine whether the policy would subsequently grasp/open/release under the unchanged reference clock.
post_timeout_diagnostic_proposal.bounded_cases: At most 4 no-learning u10000 runs: pull/push on the original 2 ms Warp and native 3.3.0, from frame0, same actor/history/action map/reference clock.
post_timeout_diagnostic_proposal.state_rule: Rerun from frame0 to preserve solver/servo state and real history; do not splice a q/v-only terminal snapshot. Reproduce and permanently record the original formal first failure before diagnostic continuation.
post_timeout_diagnostic_proposal.after_timeout: Only after the formal task is already recorded failed, continue the same actor every 20 ms on real successors, with no stage reset, no reference pause, no teacher action and no extension beyond the original reference tail. Use the existing reference-phase physical termination semantics and record every original force/contact/support/limit/saturation violation; stop at the first such physical termination or the reference tail.
post_timeout_diagnostic_proposal.interpretation: Can distinguish a pure early task-readiness stop from absent later physical contact capability. A later opening remains a diagnostic observation, not a formal pass, qualified normalized return, independent full benchmark or V0.
post_timeout_diagnostic_proposal.limitations: Original contact fragments also lost push ability at u10000. Therefore even a favorable geometric endpoint explanation cannot establish that the full task is solved behind the judge.

actual_training_closure_recommendation.sequence: Run the offline geometric/clock pass and the bounded no-learning continuation in parallel with only already justified work. Use their result together with the official-flow/WM review to pre-register one original-core training experiment in the same execution round.
actual_training_closure_recommendation.if_mapping_bug_proven: Fix only the evidenced transfer mapping/clock/units defect, preserve official core/loss/observation and run matched retained/restored branches from the same archived boundary; include original formal plus diagnostic metrics at fixed endpoints. Label changed environment identity explicitly.
actual_training_closure_recommendation.if_no_mapping_bug: Do not claim a fix or silently shift the reference/event clock. Any newly budgeted standard continuation or reference-data/observable change must be stated as that experimental choice, with the old u10000 closure preserved. A task-definition or observation change is not an official reproduction fix.
actual_training_closure_recommendation.budget_advice: Use one bounded registered training block with concrete checkpoints and original physical scoring, not another sequence of WM-only readiness gates. Exact continuation/paired budget should be set by the parent after combining the other source and WM audits; this physics evidence alone does not justify a further unconditional 5000 updates.
actual_training_closure_recommendation.acceptance: Original formal results remain authoritative. If a candidate completes a frame0 case under the original judge, create the genuine same-episode success video immediately.
